pages.text: $(bold)Mana Pedestal$(): the $(bold)only$() way to charge an Elder Crystal.$(br2)$(li)Right-click the pedestal while holding an $(bold)Elder Crystal$() to place it$(li)Whenever the pedestal holds one, $(bold)right-click takes it back$() (EE included) - $(bold)no empty hand and no sneaking needed$(), whatever you happen to be holding$(li)$(italic)If the pedestal is empty and you are not holding a crystal, the click does nothing at all; and while the pedestal is occupied, placing a second crystal is impossible anyway, so that right-click can only mean "take" - hence no precondition is needed$()$(li)Elder Crystal $(bold)blocks above / below / beside$() the pedestal are charged as well (4000 EE each; the crystal on the pedestal is filled first)$(br2)$(italic)Crafting: echo shard on top; Elder Crystal + Rlyeh Call + Elder Crystal in the middle; deepslate x3 at the bottom (next page).$()

pages.title: Charging rule: darker is faster
pages.text: $(bold)The darker it is, the faster it charges.$()$(br2)One formula only:$(br2)$(bold)rate = full speed x (light cap - light above the pedestal) / light cap$()$(br2)$(li)$(bold)light$() = block light + sky light combined into a single 0..15 value (the very same number vanilla uses for mob spawning)$(li)$(bold)light 0$() gives full speed: $(bold)5 EE/s$() by default (= 100 EE per minute, so a 1000 EE crystal takes about $(bold)3.3 minutes$())$(li)$(bold)light >= 15$() gives $(bold)no charging at all$() (default settings)$(li)Examples: light 12 => 1.0 EE/s; light 14 => 0.33 EE/s$(br2)$(bold)Consequences$() (no extra rules to memorise): a night outdoors is dark, so it is fast; daylight outdoors does not charge; a $(bold)pitch black cave charges at full speed even at noon$(); there is deliberately $(bold)no$() "must be night" or "must see the sky" condition.$(br2)$(italic)Caveat: crystal blocks $(bold)glow$() (light level 7), so stacking them right against the pedestal slows charging a little.$()

pages.title: Config keys
pages.text: In $(italic)config/mofengbaizhi/tinkersnewlife-common.toml$(), section $(bold)[elder_crystal]$():$(br2)$(li)$(bold)pedestal_charge_max_per_second$(): full speed at light 0 (default $(bold)5.0$() EE/s)$(li)$(bold)pedestal_light_cap$(): light level at which charging stops (default $(bold)15$(); raise it above 15 for a slow trickle in bright light - at 16, light 15 still gives about 0.31 EE/s)$(li)$(bold)pedestal_source$(): which ambient energy source to use (default $(bold)light_level$() = darker is faster; an unknown id quietly falls back to it)$(li)$(bold)pedestal_particles$() / $(bold)pedestal_sound$(): cold-coloured particles / a soft chime while charging$(br2)Charging stops when everything is full: a crystal item holds $(bold)1000$() EE, a crystal block $(bold)4000$().

pages.title: Other energy sources later
pages.text: The $(bold)energy conversion system$() (turning another mod's mana/energy into EE) is $(bold)not$() part of this release - but the interface is already in place:$(br2)$(li)A source is a $(bold)pluggable piece of logic$() implementing $(italic)AmbientEnergySource$() ("how much EE per second can this position give me?")$(li)The default implementation $(italic)LightLevelEnergySource$() is exactly the "darker is faster" rule above$(li)The pedestal block and its block entity know $(bold)nothing$() about light, night or weather - they just ask "which source is selected?" once per second$(br2)=> to hook up another source later: write a new implementation, register one line in $(italic)AmbientEnergySources$(), and point $(bold)pedestal_source$() at it. $(bold)No block changes needed$().$(br2)$(italic)Cross-system conversion (mana / souls / curse <-> EE) always goes through $(bold)EnergyUnits$(), the single conversion table.$()
$(bold)Recipe$():$(br2)top row middle: echo shard$(br)middle row: Elder Crystal + Rlyeh Call + Elder Crystal$(br)bottom row: deepslate x3
